qualified_claim: On this Linux OS keychain, cooperating same-user current-version processes serialize per-entry storage operations and condition retirement on the saved version, including identical-token replacements.
supersedes_component_failure: KEYCHAIN-FRESHNESS-QUALIFICATION.json preserves the positively reproduced identical-token retirement failure at its own source. This report qualifies the replacement transaction component only.

implementation.primary_format: Unchanged raw token in the AetherSDR OS keychain service.
implementation.sidecar: TailnetShim/Version/<SHA256 primary key>; bounded schema-1 nonce, token hash and commit marker in the same OS keychain.
implementation.authority: Per-entry QLockFile held until admitted OS backend completion. Unix profiles share a fixed UID-owned 0700 /tmp directory independent of TMPDIR and settings profile.
implementation.write: Validate known metadata; persist pending new nonce; replace primary; verify primary; commit nonce. Never remove the old primary before writing the new one.
implementation.retire: Under the same lease, re-read primary and committed nonce, compare both, mark pending, remove primary and then metadata. Completion reports actual persistent removal.
implementation.lifetime: Application-owned operation survives facade/window destruction. A queue/admission deadline cannot release authority for an already started backend operation.
implementation.legacy_and_uncertainty: Legacy primary and known interrupted metadata retain readable primary without retirement authority. Unknown/malformed/future metadata is preserved and refused. Explicit retry can recover known pending stages.
implementation.bounds: 4 KiB token, 2 KiB key, 512 B metadata, 256 global and 16 per-entry queued operations; at most 10 seconds waiting for admission.
implementation.fallback: Production QKeychain read, write and remove jobs explicitly disable insecure plaintext fallback.
implementation.integration: No new thread, GUI/core include, dependency, radio command or external API.

verification.injected_component: Normal and ASan/UBSan/LSan runs passed. Injected backend/lease only; no real credentials, files or sockets in default CTest.

real_Linux_backend.backend: QtKeychain 0.18.0 / GNOME Keyring 51.1; Qt 6.12.0; Linux x86_64.
real_Linux_backend.crash_limits: Only fixture children killed; phases pause before primary submission or after its backend ACK. Opaque backend operations at an arbitrary crash instant and machine power loss are not qualified.
